verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no first-party way to issue scoped or least-privilege API credentials for an agent. The `login:ci` command generates a non-interactive authentication token, but nothing documents scoping or restricting it. Security Rules control which data end users can access, which is an adjacent control rather than issuing scoped credentials.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
